title_en: At Vizion Plus Complex, 2+1+2 Apartment with Regular Layout for Sale!
description_en: At Vizion Plus Complex, in Don Bosco, Super Apartment 2+1+2 Fully Invested!!! The apartment is located on the 9th floor of one of the complex's well-managed buildings with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​124 m2 and a net area of ​​114 m2, with a South-East orientation. The apartment is organized by a corridor that divides the living room, which is spacious, together with the kitchen area and access to the balcony, 2 bedrooms, one of which is a double with a dedicated bathroom, a bedroom for children and a toilet. The area offers many facilities, starting from the perfect location, the proximity to the Center and the institutions, and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment. The property has full mortgage documentation.
